summary: This bill expands the authority of United States Postal Service police officers to include the protection of Postal Service property and individuals on that property, and allows the Postmaster General to set regulations and penalties for violations on Postal Service property.

scores.thoughts: This bill modifies the role and duties of United States Postal Service police officers, explicitly including them alongside Postal Inspectors in certain authorities and clarifying their power to enforce regulations on Postal Service property. This strengthens the enforcement capabilities of law enforcement within the Postal Service, aligning with stricter justice and stronger policing.
